column1: # One row per column the implemented tools write: the Picard metrics class, the column, its type
# (int, float or string) and a definition written from the Picard 3.5.0 behaviour the tool
# reproduces. Histogram columns have no metrics class; their first field is the Picard program
# name instead, and a label that varies by accumulation unit, orientation or library is written
# with a * for the varying part. Tab separated; lines starting with # are skipped.

column4: definition

Median insert size (absolute TLEN) of the counted pairs in this row's PAIR_ORIENTATION and accumulation unit. Half-integer when the pair count is even and the two middle sizes differ by an odd number.
Most frequent insert size; the smallest one on a tie.
Median of the absolute distances from the median insert size. About SD / 1.4826 for a normal distribution.
Smallest insert size seen. Usually an alignment artefact rather than a real fragment.
Largest insert size seen. A very large value points to an artefact or a rearrangement.

Mean of the insert sizes up to median + DEVIATIONS (default 10) x MAD, or up to HISTOGRAM_WIDTH if given. Only the upper tail is cut; small sizes stay in. MIN_HISTOGRAM_WIDTH raises the computed width but is ignored when HISTOGRAM_WIDTH is set.

Sample standard deviation (n - 1) of the insert sizes kept after the upper-tail cut described under MEAN_INSERT_SIZE. ? for a single pair; 0 when HISTOGRAM_WIDTH sits below the smallest insert size and nothing is kept.

Number of pairs in this orientation and unit, counted once per template from the second-of-pair read. A pair counts only if both mates are mapped to the same contig, TLEN is not 0, neither record is secondary or supplementary, and the read is not a duplicate unless INCLUDE_DUPLICATES is set. The count is taken before the upper-tail cut.
FR (mates face each other), RF (mates face away) or TANDEM (same strand). An orientation gets a row only when it holds at least MINIMUM_PCT (default 0.05) of the unit's pairs.
Width of the smallest symmetric window around the median that holds 10% of the pairs.
Width of the smallest symmetric window around the median that holds 20% of the pairs.
Width of the smallest symmetric window around the median that holds 30% of the pairs.
Width of the smallest symmetric window around the median that holds 40% of the pairs.
Width of the smallest symmetric window around the median that holds 50% of the pairs.
Width of the smallest symmetric window around the median that holds 60% of the pairs.
Width of the smallest symmetric window around the median that holds 70% of the pairs. Half of it approximates the SD of a normal distribution.
Width of the smallest symmetric window around the median that holds 80% of the pairs.
Width of the smallest symmetric window around the median that holds 90% of the pairs.
Width of the smallest symmetric window around the median that holds 95% of the pairs.
Width of the smallest symmetric window around the median that holds 99% of the pairs.
Sample (@RG SM) of the accumulation unit. Empty on the ALL_READS row.
Library (@RG LB) of the accumulation unit. Empty on ALL_READS and SAMPLE rows.
Platform unit (@RG PU) of the read group. Empty except on READ_GROUP rows.
Which reads the row counts: UNPAIRED, FIRST_OF_PAIR, SECOND_OF_PAIR, or PAIR for both mates together.
Primary reads in the category, passing filter or not. Secondary and supplementary alignments are not counted. A PAIR row counts both mates.
Reads without the QC-fail flag (0x200).
PF_READS / TOTAL_READS.
PF reads that carry the tag XN=1, the Illumina noise-read mark. The bases are not inspected.
PF reads with a mapped primary alignment, at any mapping quality.
PF_READS_ALIGNED / PF_READS.
Bases of PF aligned reads inside alignment blocks (M, = and X CIGAR operations).
PF aligned reads with mapping quality 20 or more.
Aligned bases of the PF_HQ_ALIGNED_READS.
PF_HQ_ALIGNED_BASES whose base quality is 20 or more.

Median over all PF aligned reads of the mismatches counted in mapping quality 20 or more alignments. A read below mapping quality 20 enters as 0, so many low-quality reads pull the median toward 0. Needs REFERENCE_SEQUENCE, else 0.
Mismatching bases / PF_ALIGNED_BASES, over all PF aligned reads.
Mismatching bases / PF_HQ_ALIGNED_BASES, over the mapping quality 20 or more reads.
Insertion and deletion events (CIGAR I and D operations, not bases) per aligned base: (insertions + deletions) / PF_ALIGNED_BASES. A fraction, not multiplied by 100.
Mean length of the stored sequence of all PF reads, mapped or not. Soft-clipped bases count; hard-clipped bases do not, because they are absent from the record.
Standard deviation of the stored sequence lengths of all PF reads. Soft-clipped bases count; hard-clipped bases do not.
Median stored sequence length of all PF reads. Soft-clipped bases count; hard-clipped bases do not.
Median absolute deviation of the stored sequence lengths of all PF reads (soft clips included, hard clips not).
Shortest stored sequence among PF reads. Soft-clipped bases count; hard-clipped bases do not.
Longest stored sequence among PF reads. Soft-clipped bases count; hard-clipped bases do not.

Mean, over all PF reads, of the bases in M, I, = and X operations; clipped bases are left out. Unmapped PF reads enter as 0 and insertions count, so the value is lower than the mean aligned-block length.
PF aligned reads whose mate is mapped too.
READS_ALIGNED_IN_PAIRS / PF_READS_ALIGNED.
PF aligned primary reads that are paired (flag 0x1) but lack the proper-pair flag (0x2). Unpaired reads never count.
PF_READS_IMPROPER_PAIRS / PF_READS_ALIGNED.

Machine cycles where no-calls reach 80% of the category's TOTAL_READS, QC-failed reads included in the denominator. On PF aligned reads a mismatch to the reference also counts as a bad call. The PAIR row is the sum of FIRST_OF_PAIR and SECOND_OF_PAIR.
PF reads aligned to the forward strand / PF_READS_ALIGNED.

Share of PF aligned primary reads that look chimeric, among those that qualify. A read with a mapped mate qualifies when both ends have mapping quality 20 or more, or its MQ tag is missing; any other read qualifies at mapping quality 20 or more. It is chimeric when |TLEN| exceeds MAX_INSERT_SIZE (default 100000), the mate is on another contig, the orientation is outside EXPECTED_PAIR_ORIENTATIONS (default FR), or the read itself has an SA tag.
Share of PF reads that are unmapped or mapping quality 0 and begin with a known adapter sequence.
Soft-clipped bases of PF mapped primary reads / total bases of all PF reads (stored sequence length, unmapped reads included). The denominator is not PF_ALIGNED_BASES.
Hard-clipped bases (CIGAR H) of PF primary reads / total bases of all PF reads (stored sequence length). The hard-clipped bases are not in the denominator, and PF_ALIGNED_BASES is not used.

Each target goes into one whole-percent GC bin by its own GC. Over bins 0 to 50, sum (share of target bases in the bin - share of high-quality on-target bases in the bin) where positive, times 100. Value is a percentage (0 to 100), not a fraction. 0 when no reference is given.
The AT_DROPOUT sum over bins 50 to 100. Bin 50 is in both sums. A percentage (0 to 100), measured in high-quality on-target bases, not reads. 0 when no reference is given.

Modelled probability of calling a heterozygous SNP at a log-odds threshold of 3, from the depth distribution of target bases (depth capped at COVERAGE_CAP) and the quality distribution of on-target bases. GC content of the window, in percent from 0 to 100; one row per value.
Reference windows of SCAN_WINDOW_SIZE (100) bases with this GC content. Windows with five or more N, and the first and last window of each contig, are not counted.

Mapped reads assigned to a window with this GC content: the window at the alignment start, or for a reverse-strand read the window that ends at the alignment end. Reads whose window starts before base 1 or has five or more N are not counted.

Phred-scaled rate of mismatches plus inserted and deleted bases against the reference, over the bases of the reads assigned to these windows. It does not use the base qualities in the file, and it is 0 when the bin has no error.
Read starts per window in this bin divided by read starts per window over the whole reference. 1 is average.
Half-width of the error bar of NORMALIZED_COVERAGE from the read start count: NORMALIZED_COVERAGE / sqrt(READ_STARTS).

Library (@RG LB) the row describes. Reads without a library are listed as "Unknown Library" by CollectDuplicateMetrics and as "Unknown" by EstimateLibraryComplexity, which also files any pair whose read name has no tile, x and y there.
Mapped primary reads that are unpaired (no pair flag) or whose mate is unmapped. Always 0 from EstimateLibraryComplexity.

CollectDuplicateMetrics and MarkDuplicates: pairs with both mates mapped, primary records only, counted per record and halved. EstimateLibraryComplexity: pairs that passed its quality check, mapped or not, in set sizes seen at least MIN_GROUP_COUNT times.
Mapped secondary or supplementary records, left out of the other counts. An unmapped record counts only in UNMAPPED_READS. Always 0 from EstimateLibraryComplexity.
Records with the unmapped flag, whatever their secondary or supplementary flags. Always 0 from EstimateLibraryComplexity.

CollectDuplicateMetrics: examined pairs whose records carry the duplicate flag. MarkDuplicates: examined pairs it flagged, optical ones included, counted per record and halved. EstimateLibraryComplexity: in each set of identical pairs, every pair after the first.

Duplicate pairs within OPTICAL_DUPLICATE_PIXEL_DISTANCE of another pair on the same tile. Found among the pairs of each duplicate set against the pair kept. 0 from CollectDuplicateMetrics, which has no read positions.

Fraction of examined reads that are duplicates, from 0 to 1 (0.25 is 25%): (UNPAIRED_READ_DUPLICATES + 2 x READ_PAIR_DUPLICATES) / (UNPAIRED_READS_EXAMINED + 2 x READ_PAIRS_EXAMINED). 0 when nothing was examined.

Distinct molecules in the library, from the Lander-Waterman equation over the non-optical pairs and the unique pairs (pairs minus duplicates), truncated to a whole number. Empty when there are no pairs or no duplicate pair beyond the optical ones.
1 for unpaired and first-of-pair records, 2 for second-of-pair records. Secondary and supplementary records are not counted, and PF_READS_ONLY and ALIGNED_READS_ONLY narrow the rest.

Sequencing cycle, 1-based, with reverse-strand records flipped. READ_END 2 cycles are numbered after the last READ_END 1 cycle, so the first base of the second read prints as the first read's length plus 1.

First-of-pair or unpaired reads over one gene that fit neither model: mate unmapped or on another contig, not FR, or the template extends past the gene.

Unfiltered records where this is the only sample with a variant and it has one variant chromosome (a het).

Coverage within 0.5% of the transcript length around this position, divided by the transcript's mean coverage, averaged over the picked transcripts of the unit named before the dot (All_Reads, or the read group, library or sample). 1 is flat; the last base of each alignment block is not counted.
